H7300.def: a primitive root; to tramp about, i.e. ramble (free or disconsolate):--have the dominion, be lord, mourn, rule.

H7301.def: a primitive root; to slake the thirst (occasionally of other appetites):--bathe, make drunk, (take the) fill, satiate, (abundantly) satisfy, soak, water (abundantly).

H7303.et: from an unused root probably meaning to cry out
H7303.def: from an unused root probably meaning to cry out; outcry; Rohagah, an Israelite:--Rohgah.

H7304.def: a primitive root (identical with «07306»); properly, to breathe freely, i.e. revive; by implication, to have ample room:--be refreshed, large.

H7305.def: from «07304»; room, literally (an interval) or figuratively (deliverance):--enlargement, space.

H7306.def: a primitive root; properly, to blow, i.e. breathe; only (literally) to smell or (by implication, perceive (figuratively, to anticipate, enjoy):--accept, smell, × touch, make of quick understanding.

H7307.def: from «07306»; wind; by resemblance breath, i.e. a sensible (or even violent) exhalation; figuratively, life, anger, unsubstantiality; by extension, a region of the sky; by resemblance spirit, but only of a rational being (including its expression and functions):--air, anger, blast, breath, × cool, courage, mind, × quarter, × side, spirit((-ual)), tempest, × vain, ((whirl-))wind(-y).

H7311.def: a primitive root; to be high actively, to rise or raise (in various applications, literally or figuratively):--bring up, exalt (self), extol, give, go up, haughty, heave (up), (be, lift up on, make on, set up on, too) high(-er, one), hold up, levy, lift(-er) up, (be) lofty, (X a-)loud, mount up, offer (up), + presumptuously, (be) promote(-ion), proud, set up, tall(-er), take (away, off, up), breed worms.

H7312.def: or rum {room}; from «07311»; (literally) elevation or (figuratively) elation:--haughtiness, height, × high.

H7313.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «07311»; (figuratively only):-- extol, lift up (self), set up.

H7316.def: from «07311»; height; Rumah, a place in Palestine:--Rumah.

H7318.def: from «07426»; exaltation, i.e. (figuratively and specifically) praise:--be extolled.

H7319.def: feminine active participle of «07426»; exaltation, i.e. praise:--high.

H7320.def: (or Romam from «07311» and «05828»; I have raised up a help; Romamti-Ezer, an Israelite:--Romamti- ezer.

H7321.def: a primitive root; to mar (especially by breaking); figuratively, to split the ears (with sound), i.e. shout (for alarm or joy):--blow an alarm, cry (alarm, aloud, out), destroy, make a joyful noise, smart, shout (for joy), sound an alarm, triumph.

H7322.def: a primitive root; properly, to triturate (in a mortar), i.e. (figuratively) to agitate (by concussion):--tremble.

H7323.def: a primitive root; to run (for whatever reason, especially to rush):--break down, divide speedily, footman, guard, bring hastily, (make) run (away, through), post.

H7324.def: a primitive root; to pour out (literally or figuratively), i.e. empty:--X arm, cast out, draw (out), (make) empty, pour forth (out).

H7325.def: a primitive root; to slaver (with spittle), i.e. (by analogy) to emit a fluid (ulcerous or natural):--run.

H7326.def: a primitive root; to be destitute:--lack, needy, (make self) poor (man).

H7327.def: probably for «07468»; friend; Ruth, a Moabitess:--Ruth.

H7328.et: from an unused root probably meaning to attenuate, ie (fig) hide
H7328.def: (Aramaic) from an unused root probably meaning to attenuate, i.e. (figuratively) hide; a mystery:--secret.

H7329.def: a primitive root; to emaciate, i.e. make (become) thin (literally or figuratively):--famish, wax lean.

H7335.def: a primitive root; to twinkle the eye (in mockery): wink.

H7336.def: a primitive root; probably to be heavy, i.e. (figuratively) honorable:--prince, ruler.

H7337.def: a primitive root; to broaden (intransitive or transitive, literal or figurative):--be an en-(make) large(-ing), make room, make (open) wide.

H7339.def: or rchowb {rekh-obe'}; from «07337»; a width, i.e. (concretely) avenue or area:--broad place (way), street. See also «01050».

H7340.def: or Rchowb {rekh-obe'}; the same as «07339»; Rechob, the name of a place in Syria, also of a Syrian and an Israelite:--Rehob.

H7341.def: from «07337»; width (literally or figuratively):--breadth, broad, largeness, thickness, wideness.

H7342.def: from «07337»; roomy, in any (or every) direction, literally or figuratively:--broad, large, at liberty, proud, wide.

H7343.def: the same as «07342»; proud; Rachab, a Canaanitess:--Rahab.

H7344.def: or Rchoboth {rekh-o-both'}; plural of «07339»; streets; Rechoboth, a place in Assyria and one in Palestine:-- Rehoboth.

H7345.def: or Rchabyahuw {rek-ab-yaw'-hoo}; from «07337» and «03050»; Jah has enlarged; Rechabjah, an Israelite:--Rehabiah.

H7346.def: from «07337» and «05971»; a people has enlarged; Rechabam, an Israelite king:--Rehoboam.

H7347.et: from an unused root meaning to pulverise
H7347.def: from an unused root meaning to pulverize; a mill-stone:--mill (stone).

H7348.def: a form of «07349»; Rechum, the name of a Persian and of three Israelites:--Rehum.

H7350.def: or rachoq {raw-khoke'}; from «07368»; remote, literally or figuratively, of place or time; specifically, precious; often used adverbially (with preposition):--(a-)far (abroad, off), long ago, of old, space, great while to come.

H7351.def: from the same as «07298»; a panel (as resembling a trough):--rafter.

H7353.et: from an unused root meaning to journey
H7353.def: from an unused root meaning to journey; a ewe (the females being the predominant element of a flock) (as a good traveller):--ewe, sheep.

H7354.def: the same as «07353»; Rachel, a wife of Jacob:--Rachel.

H7355.def: a primitive root; to fondle; by implication, to love, especially to compassionate:--have compassion (on, upon), love, (find, have, obtain, shew) mercy(-iful, on, upon), (have) pity, Ruhamah, × surely.

H7356.def: from «07355»; compassion (in the plural); by extension, the womb (as cherishing the fetus); by implication, a maiden:-- bowels, compassion, damsel, tender love, (great, tender) mercy, pity, womb.

H7357.def: the same as «07356»; pity; Racham, an Israelite:--Raham.

H7360.def: or (feminine) rachamah {raw-khaw-maw'}; from «07355»; a kind of vulture (supposed to be tender towards its young):--gier- eagle.

H7363.def: a primitive root; to brood; by implication, to be relaxed:--flutter, move, shake.

H7364.def: a primitive root; to lave (the whole or a part of a thing):--bathe (self), wash (self).

H7365.et: corresponding to (07364) [probably through the accessory idea of ministering as a servant at the bath]
H7365.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «07364» (probably through the accessory idea of ministering as a servant at the bath); to attend upon:--trust.

H7368.def: a primitive root; to widen (in any direction), i.e. (intransitively) recede or (transitively) remove (literally or figuratively, of place or relation):--(a-, be, cast, drive, get, go, keep (self), put, remove, be too, (wander), withdraw) far (away, off), loose, × refrain, very, (be) a good way (off).

H7371.def: from «07306»; a winnowing-fork (as blowing the chaff away):--shovel.

H7372.def: a primitive root; to be moist:--be wet.

H7374.et: from an unused root meaning to tremble
H7374.def: from an unused root meaning to tremble; terror:--fear.

H7375.def: a root compounded from «07373» and «02954»; to be rejuvenated:--be fresh.

H7376.def: a primitive root; to dash down:--dash (in pieces).

H7378.def: or ruwb {roob}; a primitive root; properly, to toss, i.e. grapple; mostly figuratively, to wrangle, i.e. hold a controversy; (by implication) to defend:--adversary, chide, complain, contend, debate, × ever, × lay wait, plead, rebuke, strive, × thoroughly.

H7379.def: or rib {reeb}; from «07378»; a contest (personal or legal):--+ adversary, cause, chiding, contend(-tion), controversy, multitude (from the margin), pleading, strife, strive(-ing), suit.

H7381.def: from «07306»; odor (as if blown):--savour, scent, smell.

H7383.def: or riphah {ree-faw'}; from «07322»; (only plural), grits (as pounded):--ground corn, wheat.

H7384.def: or (probably by orthographical error) Diyphath {dee-fath'}; of foreign origin; Riphath, a grandson of Japheth and his descendants:--Riphath.

H7385.def: from «07324»; emptiness; figuratively, a worthless thing; adverbially, in vain:--empty, to no purpose, (in) vain (thing), vanity.

H7386.def: or (shorter) req {rake}; from «07324»; empty; figuratively, worthless:--emptied(-ty), vain (fellow, man).

H7387.def: from «07386»; emptily; figuratively (objective) ineffectually, (subjective) undeservedly:--without cause, empty, in vain, void.

H7388.def: from «07325»; saliva; by resemblance, broth:--spittle, white (of an egg).

H7389.def: or resh {raysh}; or riysh {reesh}; from «07326»; poverty:--poverty.

H7390.def: from «07401»; tender (literally or figuratively); by implication, weak:--faint((-hearted), soft, tender ((-hearted), one), weak.

H7392.def: a primitive root; to ride (on an animal or in a vehicle); causatively, to place upon (for riding or generally), to despatch:--bring (on (horse-)back), carry, get (oneself) up, on (horse-)back, put, (cause to, make to) ride (in a chariot, on, -r), set.

H7393.def: from «07392»; a vehicle; by implication, a team; by extension, cavalry; by analogy a rider, i.e. the upper millstone:--chariot, (upper) millstone, multitude (from the margin), wagon.

H7394.def: from «07392»; rider; Rekab, the name of two Arabs and of two Israelites:--Rechab.

H7395.def: from «07392»; a charioteer:--chariot man, driver of a chariot, horseman.

H7397.def: probably feminine from «07401»; softness; Rekah, a place in Palestine:--Rechah.

H7398.def: from passive participle of «07392»; a vehicle (as ridden on):--chariot.

H7399.def: or rkush {rek-oosh'}; from passive participle of «07408»; property (as gathered):--good, riches, substance.
